title: Recorded values generated from their value types and weights, not from a sample export
note: AI-AG-007 with FR-DOM-001's sensitivity labels and FR-POL-006: a number gets a range, an option set gets weights that match the domain, and the extremes that a validation rule or a coloured cell depends on are named as boundary cases. Still a specification, not rows.

items.label: demo-acceptance-visits.md
items.content: Demo acceptance for visits: the raised blood pressure column has to show all three answers, the coverage report needs a trend across the year rather than a flat line, and a trainer wants at least one visit that the validation rule refuses so the error state can be shown.

expected.summary: Specified the visit events: 900 events over twelve months, weights drawn from a plausible range with a few at and below the validation boundary, systolic pressures spanning normal to raised, and the option set weighted so all three answers appear without being one third each — which no clinic looks like. Every value is generated by a strategy against an approved element; nothing is copied from a sample export, and the one export in this project's inputs is classified PHI_PII and is not a basis. The boundary cases are the ones the acceptance note names, including the record a validation rule refuses.

decisions.subject: fx.visit.events

selected.option: one specification over the visit event, with per-attribute strategies

alternatives.reasonRejected: The elements of a visit have to agree with each other; three independent generators produce a visit whose blood pressure flag contradicts its systolic reading.

decisions.rationale: A visit is one record with several values, so the distribution is stated once and the attributes hang off it.

distribution.shape: gently rising across the year so the coverage report has a trend
distribution.overOrgUnit: proportional to the pregnancy population of each facility

boundaryCases: one visit whose weight is below the validation rule's lower bound, so the rejection path can be demonstrated
one visit with the highest systolic value in the set and the flag set to yes, so the coloured cell and the reading agree
one visit in every period, so no month of the coverage report is blank by accident
a visit where the flag is not measured but a systolic value exists

periods.cadence: at least one visit per facility per month
